name: local-agent-workbench
description: Runs the offline local agent workbench commands from VS Code.

commands.title: LAWB: Extract text from the active PDF
LAWB: Build diagram from the active JSON spec
LAWB: PRISMA counts from the active CSV
LAWB: Run error loop on the active project folder

lawb.repoPath.description: Folder that contains the workbench (the folder with src/lawb). Required.

lawb.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter that has the workbench dependencies.

lawb.model.description: Model used by the error loop. Use a local model name, or provider:model if cloud is enabled.
